non_claims: The current Kaggle image has not been identified.
Linker-visible libcuda has not been proven.
Minimal Triton compilation has not been proven.
TRITON_ATTN has not been added to canonical worker argv.
One-worker Triton startup has not been proven.
Cache telemetry and reset remain unqualified.
Measured A/B/C execution has not occurred.
The result does not establish production readiness.

probes.name: KAGGLE_IMAGE_AND_RUNTIME_IDENTITY
probes.question: What exact Kaggle GPU image, CUDA, compiler, linker, and driver-library environment is active?

probes.name: CUDA_DRIVER_LINKER_VISIBILITY
probes.question: Can the active environment resolve and link a minimal artifact with -lcuda without an unapproved filesystem mutation?

probes.name: MINIMAL_TRITON_KERNEL
probes.question: Can the current pinned runtime compile and execute one minimal Triton kernel on Tesla T4?

probes.name: ONE_WORKER_EXPLICIT_TRITON_STARTUP
probes.question: Can one canonical vLLM worker start with explicit TRITON_ATTN and prove backend realization?

probes.name: ONE_DETERMINISTIC_REQUEST
probes.question: Can the worker complete one bounded deterministic request with valid structured output?

probes.name: PREFIX_CACHE_SMOKE_AND_RESET
probes.question: Can same-worker prefix reuse, request-attributable telemetry, and a clean reset baseline be proven?

probes.name: DUAL_PROCESS_FEASIBILITY
probes.question: Can two isolated workers coexist with correct GPU, port, process, and metrics separation?
